attention.definition: Complete exact-name X count queries over seven adjacent windows; reposts excluded; a post can match more than one model.

sentiment.definition: One expressed opinion per author/model/week in the time-stratified captured sample; comments included; not a poll of all X users.

preference.definition: One adjudicated directional preference per author/exact-model pair/week. Pair splits and XbenchPref describe the captured sample.

switching.definition: Completed first-person moves between two exact tracked model versions; one author/edge/week.

harnesses.definition: Claude Code versus OpenAI Codex coding-harness preferences; separate from model rankings.
